items.text: Iswamauni etem lokisupuruunet lukisupurununo: iswamauni ŋes kakito nuka sita.
alalauke da ekubit; eraun loka agoria aoŋon nueriakanara: amukururuke ikubitin iarei: amumwarake eraunos nuka ibore idiopet kaŋes,
Iladaari ŋes kesabu loelai, kujuke, ka isiepionoke, ka amumwarake; iswamakini ŋes atorosit naka esabu airimor.
Iswamakini ŋes igilun iarei luka esabu kwap katorositike, amaranake aarei, iswamakini kes osiepionoke iarei; eraunos aiboisio nuka adaketa adakia ŋes.
Iswamauni adaketa nuka akito nuka sita iladaari kes kesabu.
Ibwaikini ŋes kinaren kaigalisit naejai eiduny kasaduku naka aitejenunet, kinaren keicolon-lokaitim loejai kuju kaitejenunet, nekiriamun kajo.
Isupuruuni Aaron kanen lukisupurununo luka lueuru maa: ninitupuruc, naitemonokinio ŋesi atalai isupuruuni kes.
Nainokokinia Aaron atalai eboŋ, isupuruuni kes, lukisupurununo lumam edaunos kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT anatar aturiokus.
Mam isupuruunete lukisupurununo luegelakina kanen, karaida ainakinet naicweio, karaida ainakinet naka akiria; mam ibukokinete ainakinet namatat nen.
Eluci Aaron amumwara nuka etem irwan atipet ŋolikaru: kaokot nuka ainakinet naka adiakaret eluci ŋes atipet nolikaru anatar aturiokus: erai lokalaunan noi kama ejai EJAKAIT.”
“Naimaria ijo etiai loka idwe luka Isirael, kwape ejaatar nul luimarar kakesi, einakini ninitunanan EJAKAIT lulakunete aijarake, naimaria ijo kes; tetere mam ejaun atular mamakec naimaria ijo kes.
Yen ŋes yeneinakini ninitunanan yenetubori mama ejaas luimarar, atutubet naka esekel
kwape ejaar esekel loka aibois nakalaunan, (esekel ŋes igeran akaisaarei:)
Ŋininnjanan yenetubori mama ejaas luimarar ageun kaluka ikar akaisaarei ka luedeparito einakini ainakinet naka EJAKAIT.
Mam ikabarak einakinete luedeparito, lukican da mam einakinete luikidioko, adepar atutubet naka esekel, naeinakiniata ainakinet naka EJAKAIT, alucio akusiijar.
Ŋauni apesan nuka alucio kama ejaas idwe luka Isirael, itwasamai kes aijaanakinia kowema loka airiamunun; tetere eraun aisiitunet kanuka idwe luka Isirael kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT, alucio akusiiiar.”
“Iswamauni akalaya naka aisinit, aigaŋeteke naka aisinit, ailonia: ibwaikini ŋes kidin kewema loka airiamunun ka etem, ibukokini akipi toma.
Ilosete Aaron ka odweke akecekanin ka akecekeje kanen;
Naelomanariata owema loka airiamunun, ilosete kakip, tetere mam etwakete; arai naekunyuniata otem aijaanakin, aicwe ainakinet naeinakinere kakim mama ejai EJAKAIT:
Ilosete akecekanin ka akecekeie tetere mam etwakete: eraun ekisil kamakec ikar kere, kamake ka aurike anatar aturiokec.”
“Kolem lueuru maa jokan, emina loecalara isekelin akwat akany, akinomon naewiny atutubet naka ŋol, ŋes akwat aarei ka akaisakany, akalamus da naewiny akwat aarei ka akaisakany,
Luka ekasia da akwat akany kwape ejaar csekel loka aibois nakalaunan, ka ekin
Itarauni ŋes akinyet nakinyonyoanakina nakalaunan, aures nainyalitai kwape ejaar apirianut naka ekenyalan lueuru maa: eraun akinyet nakinyonyoanakina nakalaunan.
Inyonyoanakini ewema loka airiamunun, ka asaduku naka aitejenunet,
Ka emesa ka iboroke kere, ka epir loka atala: ka ikeboro kere, ka etem loka lukisupurununo,
Ka etem loka ainakinet naicweio ka iboroke kere, ka akalaya ka aigaŋeteke.
Italauni ijo kes, koraut lukalaunak noi: yenetirori kes eraun yenikalaunan.
Inyonyoanakini Aaron ka odweke akinyet, italauni da kes, tetere keiaanakinete eoŋ kosasedotene.
Ilimokini idwc luka Isirael ebe,, Eraun na akinyet nakinyonycanakina nakalaunan kamaka anatar aturiokus.
Mam ebukokinio akuan naka ituŋanan, karaida yes aiswamaun naeputotor, kwape eiaar eiponeke: erai nakalaunan, eraun da nakalaunan kamakus.
Ŋinituŋanan yeniswamauni naeputotor, arai ninitunanan yeninyonyoikini ŋes emoit, egelario kotuŋake.’’’
Kotema EJAKAIT Musa atiar, “Koya lueuru maa, esitakite, ka onika ka egalubanum; lueuru maa ka lukisupurununo luelaete: koriakas alanirukec kere;
Iswamaunia ijo kes lukisupurununo, aures nainyalitai kwape ejaar apirianut naka ekenyalan lueuru maa, kitijiiimitete kabalan, naelai nakalaunan:
Iruki ice kakesi aidecar, ibwaikini da kinaren kaitejenunet kowema loka airiamunun, nekiriamuni kajo: eraunos lukalaunak noi kamakon.
Lukisupurununo luiswamauni ijo kwape ejaar eponekec, mam iswamaunete kanukus: eraunos lukalaunak kamakus kanuka EJAKAIT.
Ŋinitunanan yeniswamauni lueputotor, ainuunun, egelario kotuŋake.”
